# Differential oracle: generated report

Generated by `node tools/oracle/report.mjs` from `results/latest.json` + `verdicts.json`. Do not edit by hand.

**What this is.** pokefirered C compiled with clang/wasm32 (semantic reference for pure C logic) compared with the real `src/fr` TypeScript.
It is NOT a GBA emulator and NOT an exact reproduction of agbcc or the ARM ABI. `MATCH_OBSERVED` means only: no difference in the inputs tried and the effects observed. It is not a proof of equivalence.

Toolchain: Homebrew clang version 16.0.6; Homebrew LLD 16.0.6
Compile flags: `--target=wasm32 -O0 -fwrapv -funsigned-char -ffreestanding -nostdlib -w -Wno-implicit-function-declaration -Wl,--no-entry -Wl,--export-all -Wl,--allow-undefined`

## Detector validity (positive controls)
